new_cards.claim: GDT706 C019 extends f86v6.25 locally: from a hot wood-preparation share I, measure hot drug share I and heat it to stage III; the written result bundle is a drug portion led fully to the terminal heating state. The edge is ykaiin#5 → okeeeey#7; or#6 supplies the written drug-portion carrier inside the bundle, not another edge. The live rival is two separate register entries at #6/#7; changed material and operation at ofchedy#8 stop the path, so later qokaiin#9 cannot be reached by skipping it.

GDT706 retains A063 as the local working reading Drogenstoff in einen heißen Empfänger geben (put drug material into a hot receiver). It is a concrete argument-chain hypothesis, but no transformed output is written; the source retains it as a hold rather than an accepted result edge.

GDT706 retains A082 as the local working reading trockenen Drogenstoff in heißen Ansatzstoff geben (put dry drug material into hot preparation material). It is a patient/destination-order candidate, not an admitted result edge or a portable lexical meaning.

GDT708 C021/A012 proposes f106r.23#2–6: prepare medicinal composite to middle stage; then a measured share II, raw material I and hot middle stage precede a possible terminal soaked-and-completed middle-stage medicinal composite. Only #2→#6 is an edge; #3 dair, #4 al and #5 qokedy remain visible attribute carriers. Soaking and completion occur only on the right and are not inferred from prepare. The cut before #7 is analytical, not punctuation or a proven new patient; #7 may start another phase of the same material.

GDT708 A024 retains an object-block hold with state/degree → state/degree → material → terminal product ending at #7. Later oechedy#9 is a tempting finished middle-stage dried-mass reading matching drying and middle degree better, but the first terminal product at #7 and a new quantity/material start at #8 intervene. The first-terminal no-skip model therefore cannot link to #9 by omitting them; no new result edge is admitted.

GDT708 proposes a variable batch architecture: an action is followed by the shortest coherent batch card, ending at the first terminal material product or the first material, operation or grade reset. An attribute stack may precede the product; this replaces a fixed three-token result description in that working model. A012/C021 is the local product candidate, A014/A024 remain object-block holds, and shorter prefixes remain held at their first overextension. These analytical cuts do not establish written punctuation, participant changes or a portable semantic syntax.

root_decisions: GDT706/708 source-bound current cards comprise the three already complete holds; GDT707 C020 and its same-material subclaim are retained. Earlier M007 action sequence does not include C019 terminal result.
A073/A004 stopping reasons and A014 order/end are named applications of the explicit batch model, not independent positive semantic readings invented from missing prefix contents.
C021 #2 is the source action; #3–5 are attribute carriers. The LX prose saying #2–5 attributes/carriers is not adopted.
New audit files were renamed before binding to avoid legacy experiment-ID filename routing; source bytes preserved.
limits: Six historical recoveries, no new manuscript experiment, image, meaning, empirical refutation or automatic model-wide reopening.
